lines:
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant UI as Chat Workspace
  participant Core as Desktop Coordinator
  participant A as Chat A Worker
  participant B as Chat B Worker
  participant Store as Canonical Store
  User->>UI: Send in Chat A
  UI->>Core: Command(A, commandId, version)
  Core->>A: Reserve A and bind identity
  A->>Store: Freeze and stage command
  A->>A: Execute model and tools
  User->>UI: New Chat B and send
  UI->>Core: Create/select B and command(B)
  Core->>B: Reserve B and bind identity
  par A progress
    A->>Store: Commit A events
    Store-->>UI: A envelopes and activity
  and B progress
    B->>Store: Commit B events
    Store-->>UI: B envelopes and activity
  end
  User->>UI: Select A and Stop A
  UI->>Core: Cancel(A)
  Core->>A: Cancel exact A token
  A->>Store: Settle A and retain effects
  A->>Core: Release A and merge feedback
  Note over B: B continues independently
